name: segmented
title: Segmented control
description: A few options in one well; a sheet glides to the current one.
use: Two to five short, mutually exclusive options in one row, such as a view switch. As labels around native radios it is a value in a form and needs no script; as buttons with aria-pressed or links with aria-current it triggers actions or goes to sibling pages.

instead.when: Each option takes a row of its own, or needs more than a word or two
There are more options than fit in one row
The options switch between panels of content
The options filter a view and any number can be on

keyboard.action: Reaches the chosen radio of the group, or each button or link in turn
Move the choice along radios that share a name
Activate a button option; Enter follows a link option

platform.fallback: The current option carries the sheet itself and changes at once, without the glide

classes.name: segmented
classes.description: The well around the options; 38px tall, matching a button

classes.name: segmented-item
classes.description: An option: a button with aria-pressed, a link with aria-current, or a label around a segmented-input radio

classes.name: segmented-input
classes.description: The radio inside a label option; it covers the option invisibly, so the label is the target and the radio keeps the state

states.name: checked
states.description: The option around the radio is the current one: it rises as a sheet

states.name: disabled
states.description: The option around the radio takes disabled ink

states.name: pressed
states.description: A button option that is the current one; the page's script moves the attribute

states.name: selected
states.description: An option with a role that takes aria-selected, such as a tab, that is the current one

states.name: current
states.description: A link option that points at the current page

states.name: disabled
states.description: Or aria-disabled="true" on a link: disabled ink
